title: Generate and replay bounded synthetic examples
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Actual accepted synthetic examples and rejection evidence exist for every supported required family.
A recorded run compiles identically across processes without calling a model during replay.
A live local synthesis smoke is observed if the capability is available; if not, deterministic output is useful but fresh-local-generation qualification is BLOCKED.
Generator self-scores never constitute factual approval.
description: Produce the actual G1 synthetic examples from grounded seeds with admitted local generation and deterministic replay.
